findings.explanation: -7d is the search time range, not a threshold, and the SPL has no alert logic; implementation says 'Alert on step changes after installs' but no step-change detection exists (description/implementation vs spl).
findings.suggested_fix: Describe this as a trend panel over 7 days at 1-hour grain, or add a real step-change condition (for example comparison to the prior day) and state it.

findings.explanation: A trending timechart has no result rows to page on; also earliest=-24h@h conflicts with the SPL's earliest=-7d.
findings.quote: throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages
findings.suggested_fix: Present this as a dashboard search, or define the alert condition and align the time window.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: `timechart span=1h avg(amps) by pdu_name outlet` uses two split-by fields; timechart accepts only one (see https://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/Splunk/latest/SearchReference/Timechart). Concatenate pdu_name and outlet into one field first. The default limit=10 series would also collapse most outlets into OTHER.
Title says 'Power Draw' but the SPL measures outlet current in amps (tenths of amps scaled by /10), not watts.
`/10` is applied to the whole coalesce, including the fallback `outlet_amps`, which may already be in amps.

summary: The SPL splits timechart by two fields, which timechart does not support, and the prose invents an alert threshold ('-7d') and step-change alerting that the search does not implement.
